title: Healing Beds
description: With this mod, you regenerate health while sleeping
body:
This simple quality-of-life mod adds a new mechanic: you regenerate health while sleeping.

Whenever you lie down in a bed, your health will restore. No extra items, no commands — just natural recovery while you rest, making beds feel more useful and survival a bit more forgiving.

Perfect for players who want a smoother early game, a more realistic healing system, or simply a small touch of comfort without changing the core gameplay.
